text:
amanda: FYI, incident INC-472 just tripped in eu-prod. Ops put a platform-level throttle; we should hold the 16:00 release. Can we coordinate a quick reschedule and preflight checklist?

deploy-bot: Automated hold applied to release/2026.03.20.16. Release status: PAUSED. Reason: incident/INC-472. To resume, ops approval + passing preflight.

ops-oncall: Confirmed — network flap in eu-west-2, partially mitigated but still noisy. Recommend a 2-hour hold and a staggered slot when green.

sanjay: +1. We should pin the model to v2.4.1 for the reschedule to avoid the canary hitting the recently pushed quant kernels. If we need rollback, v2.3.9 is safe.

lucy: Noted on pin. Will update release notes and the rollout config: set model_tag=v2.4.1 and rollout_strategy=staggered-50/50-30m.

ryan: Ops — what's the earliest safe slot? I can move the deploybot window.

ops-oncall: Earliest safe is 18:30 UTC, assuming no recurrence. Recommend we target 19:00 UTC to give oncall time to validate.

maria: If we push to 19:00, can we still keep the scheduled postdeploy smoke tests? We need the eval harness to run for 45m before we declare green.

amanda: Yes — plan: reschedule to 19:00, canary 10% for 30m, run smoke/evals 45m, then stagger to 50/100 if no regressions. If anything abnormal, rollback plan -> revert to v2.3.9 + hotfix patch branch.

sanjay: I'll add an explicit automatic rollback hook in the release config: if avg latency > 1.5x baseline OR error-rate increase > 0.5% during canary, auto-rollback to v2.3.9.

deploy-bot: Release window updated: new_start=1679516400 (19:00 UTC). Rollout config updated: model_tag=v2.4.1, canary=10%/30m -> 50%/30m -> 100%/30m. Auto-rollback triggers set.

lucy: I pushed a short blurb to release-notes: "Rescheduled due to INC-472; pinned to v2.4.1; rollback path to v2.3.9 enabled." Also attached the changelog link /docs/releases/2026-03-20.

ops-oncall: We'll post a follow-up if the incident clears earlier. If the flap persists, we'll keep the hold and escalate.

amanda: Thanks all. Action items: sanjay add rollback hook (done), lucy update notes (done), ryan move the deploy window (done), ops continue monitoring. I'll ping 18:15 for go/no-go. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Note: deployslot reserved for 19:00 UTC. If any owner wants to release earlier, please coordinate here and get ops signoff.

ryan: I've set the deploy window and notified oncall in the calendar.

maria: I'll queue the eval jobs so they can start immediately after canary starts.

amanda: Closing thread for now — will reopen if incident state changes. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
